body.message:
Tharushi I booked 1 apartment on Airbnb that’s managed by Fam Living. 

It was booked today morning and due to the current regional situation I am stuck and my flights are rescheduled.

I know the policy you people mentioned on Airbnb is non-refundable but due to these uncertain situation and circumstances, can I put an official request for an exception case to get the refund
The booking was more than 800 AED which is a decent amount.

I know this is not a normal situation but I really hope you and your organization understand my situation
